biggest_catch: Free-night certificates are not cash and come with real strings: each of the 3 awards covers one night only at properties redeemable up to 50,000 points, some hotels add resort fees, and availability of award rooms is limited. Year-one math: up to 150,000 points of award-night redemption capacity, worth roughly $1,225 in hotel value at current third-party valuations (about 0.8 cents per Bonvoy point), minus the $95 annual fee, which leaves roughly $1,130 net in the first year if you actually use all three nights for real trips you were already taking. Only claim this if you were already going to spend $3,000 in 3 months on normal purchases; never spend extra to hit the target. Marriott's bonus eligibility rules are unusually strict: the bonus is not available if you currently hold the Boundless or received a new-cardmember bonus on certain Marriott cards in the last 24 months, and cross-issuer rules apply to American Express Marriott cards too.
catches: Only claim this if you were already going to spend the money anyway; never spend extra just to hit the $3,000 minimum, because manufactured spending turns a bonus into debt.

Year-one math: 3 free-night awards worth up to 150,000 points of redemption capacity, roughly $1,225 in hotel value at typical valuations, minus the $95 annual fee, which leaves about $1,130 net if you use all three nights on trips you were already taking. From year two the $95 fee applies without a bonus, and the annual free night you receive is capped at 35,000 points.

Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which typically knocks a few points off your credit score for a short time. Chase also uses its unpublished 5/24 pattern: applicants with five or more newly opened personal cards across any issuer in the last 24 months are generally denied.
This card's APR is around 20% or higher, so carrying a balance would wipe out the bonus fast. Pay the statement balance in full every month or this offer loses you money.

Marriott bonus eligibility is strict and multi-layered: the bonus is not available if you currently hold the Boundless or received a new-cardmember bonus on certain Marriott cards in the last 24 months, and cross-issuer restrictions apply if you hold or recently earned a bonus on American Express Marriott cards. Read the full eligibility language on the application page before applying.
Chase's unpublished 5/24 pattern: five or more new personal cards opened in the last 24 months generally means denial, even with excellent credit.

Award nights are subject to availability, each award is capped at 50,000 points per night, and certain hotels charge resort fees on award stays. The account must be open and not in default when the awards are issued.

steps: Go to the official Chase Marriott Bonvoy Boundless page and read the current offer headline, the full Marriott eligibility language, and the Pricing & Terms before anything else.

Confirm your eligibility: you do not currently hold the Boundless, have not received a new-cardmember bonus on the restricted Marriott cards in the last 24 months, and are clear of the cross-issuer American Express Marriott restrictions.
Apply online. Expect a hard credit inquiry.
Use the card for the purchases you were already planning, totaling at least $3,000 on eligible purchases within 3 months of account opening.
Pay the statement balance in full every month; do not carry a balance at the ~20%+ APR.
Allow 6-8 weeks after the spending requirement is met for the 3 Free Night Awards to be issued, and confirm they appear in your Marriott Bonvoy account.
Use each award for a one-night stay at a property redeemable up to 50,000 points per night, booking early for availability and checking for resort fees.
Before the second $95 annual fee hits, check whether the card's annual 35,000-point free night and benefits earned you more than $95 in real value, and downgrade or cancel if not.
timing: Spend $3,000 on eligible purchases within 3 months of account opening. Awards are issued after qualifying purchases, typically 6-8 weeks after the spending requirement is met.
